title: LINUXDRV-002: PWM sysfs reads parse buffers with `atoi()` without adding a terminating NUL after `read()`
summary: LINUXDRV-002: PWM sysfs reads parse buffers with `atoi()` without adding a terminating NUL after `read()`. sysfs does not append NUL bytes, so parsing can read stale stack data past the bytes returned. Capture the read length, reject full-buffer reads, append `buf[n] = '\0'`, and use `strtol()` with validation. Next: revalidate historical evidence and assign a scoped repair task; no risk acceptance or closure is implied.
